_comment: Phase LK (2026-10-09, GC.3). The preset directions and framing for an assistant's look, read by mChatAI+ AssistantLookSheet ('Give it a look' — click the assistant's face in its Assistant pane). Content, not code (RULE #1): a new direction is a PR here. No baked fallback: without this file the sheet still offers 'describe it' and 'choose a picture'. Rules from docs/ASSISTANT_LOOK_DESIGN.md: presence not performance, no photoreal humans, no mascot clones.
framing: A simple, friendly avatar icon of {subject}. One centred subject, soft studio light, plain dark background, no text, no letters, no human face, not photorealistic, square composition.
_framing: {subject} is replaced with the preset's prompt or the person's own words. Keep it short: image models drift when the framing outweighs the subject.

presets.label: Orb
presets.prompt: a glowing glass orb with a soft inner light
presets._why: The direction Lawrence picked for the Personal Assistant on 2026-10-07 (his has a thin white 'm'; models garble letters, so the preset leaves it out).

presets.label: Paper crane
presets.prompt: an origami paper crane folded from one coloured sheet

presets.label: Constellation
presets.prompt: a small constellation of connected stars forming a simple shape
